# Ryther

> > Ryther provides comprehensive mental health and behavioral health services for children, youth, and families in Seattle, including residential treatment, outpatient therapy, substance use disorder programs, and psychological assessment.

Ryther is a Seattle-based nonprofit mental health organization offering trauma-informed care through evidence-based therapies including DBT, TF-CBT, ACT, and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy. The organization serves youth and families through residential programs, outpatient services, internship opportunities, and community support initiatives like the Ryther League.

## Key Topics

- Youth Mental Health
- Trauma-Informed Care
- DBT (Dialectical Behavior Therapy)
- TF-CBT (Trauma-Focused Cognitive Behavioral Therapy)
- ACT (Acceptance and Commitment Therapy)
- Substance Use Disorders
- Co-Occurring Disorders
- Residential Treatment
- Outpatient Therapy
- Child and Family Therapy
- Psychological Assessment
- Telehealth Services
- Motivational Interviewing
- Expressive Art Therapy
- ASAM (American Society of Addiction Medicine)

## Clinical Programs & Services

- [Residential Programs](https://www.ryther.org/residential-programs): Residential therapy program for youth ages 8-14 with anxiety/mood disorders
- [Psychological Assessment](https://www.ryther.org/psychological-assessment): Psychological testing for ADHD, autism, learning disabilities by Dr. Camphouse
- [Substance Use and Co-Occurring Disorders](https://www.ryther.org/internships/sud-cod): Internship program for substance use & co-occurring disorders treatment
